# CourtGrid

CourtGrid is a premium sports venue reservation platform for CourtGrid Sport Center in South Jakarta.

## Features
- Real-time court availability and booking
- Down payment via Stripe Checkout
- Customer dashboard with reservation management
- Admin panel for venue and reservation management
- E-ticket with QR code for check-in
- Indonesian (id) and English (en) locales
